item.text: The joint model’s recorded AUC exceeds both source bests, with fewer parameters and lower measured inference time than the stronger source. The moment controls leave attribution unresolved: both components together outperform neither, while either alone reduces AUC. I’ll continue the current topic to address those controls and repeatability; the same-seed results remain provisional.
